docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
Agent / Tool Call
       |
       v
 Python SDK  -->  signs payload
       |
       v
 Intent API
  - hash + verify signature
  - policy evaluation
  - multi-party approvals
  - state machine
  - durable SQLite ledger + audit log
       |
  AUTHORIZED --> execute --> COMMITTED
  PENDING --> human gate
  REJECTED

docs.title: LangChain / LangGraph
docs.text:
pip install 'quantaura-core[langchain]'

from quantaura.crypto.signatures import generate_keypair
from quantaura.sdk.python.client import IntentClient
from quantaura.integrations.langchain_tools import protect_langchain_tool

priv, _ = generate_keypair()
client = IntentClient("http://localhost:8000", "lc-agent", priv)

def write_row(msg: str) -> str:
    return f"wrote:{msg}"

gated = protect_langchain_tool(write_row, client=client, action_type="DATABASE_WRITE")
gated(msg="hello")

Every invocation submits a signed intent; the underlying function runs only if status is AUTHORIZED.

docs.title: Cryptography
docs.text:
• Canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace)
  • SHA-256 hash
  • Ed25519 signatures (PyNaCl)

docs.title: Multi-party approvals
docs.text: POST /v1/intents/{id}/approve with header X-Actor. Requires N distinct approvers when required_approvals > 1.

docs.title: QPIE — Physical Intelligence Engine
docs.text: Computational laboratory for coupled physical systems. PRISM-MATTER is a material subsystem inside the state-space.

docs.title: Invariants
docs.text:
1. Mathematical: DEC incidence satisfies d1 d0 = 0 on the grid complex.
  2. Scientific: Firewall never auto-assigns Tier 5 ("new physical law").
  3. Operational: Side effects still require the Execution Authorization Kernel.

docs.title: Quick checks
docs.text:
from quantaura.qpie import run_all_benchmarks, LatticeGaugeU1
from quantaura.qpie.dec import GridComplex2D
from quantaura.qpie.schwinger import exact_spectrum

print(run_all_benchmarks())
c = GridComplex2D(6, 6)
assert abs((c.incidence_d1() @ c.incidence_d0()).max()) < 1e-12
print(exact_spectrum(3).gap)
